source.evidence: Deterministic CPU discrete-event replay and derived economics on the exact 1,036-row request trace; not a measured endpoint result.

interpretation.one_replica_service_ceiling_is: A deployment and fleet-sizing boundary for the exact analytical trace, not a scientific promotion gate.
interpretation.continuous_cost_is: A pooled-capacity planning view that excludes finite-trace replica granularity.
interpretation.discrete_cost_is: An isolated exact-trace provisioning view that excludes storage, orchestration, failures, and reloads.
interpretation.endpoint_role: Measure the sole unconsumed endpoint so the campaign can distinguish pooled continuous economics from discrete replica economics on scope-matched runtime evidence.

endpoint_telemetry_required_if_the_bound: request submission and completion timestamps or an equivalent exact arrival-to-drain trace
sustained utilization or an equivalent busy-time measure
total tokens and exact request count
